scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.test: node --test && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm run audit:public
scripts.check:release: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run audit:history
